name: architecture
description: How should the system be shaped? ddd runs the nine-step DDD Starter Modelling Process (understand, discover, decompose, strategize, connect, organise, define, code, contracts) over one ddd/ workspace with validators, a review page and recorded decisions, advised by the ddd-decision-strategist agent; domain-modeling is the light mode for an existing codebase. Module design: codebase-design, improve-codebase-architecture, improve, architect. Decisions: architecture-decision-records. Contracts: contract-first, api-design-principles, saga-orchestration. Diagrams: Blueprint renders validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as explorable HTML; drawio writes editable .drawio files. The DDD and Blueprint tools require Node.js 18 or newer. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
